The '''Thornhedge Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located within the [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and known for its brilliance in space.

It was located between [[Coachelle Prime/Legends|Coachelle]] and [[Ota]], on the border of [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]] and [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar sector]]. The nebula was the remnant of a [[Supernova/Legends|exploded star]] in the [[Kyyr system]], which severed the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] trade route. At the center of the nebula was the [[Thornhedge Pulsar]].<ref name="TEA" />

The nebula was used in the [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] compliment, "Your presence is as daunting as the Thornhedge Nebula".
